Description: Creates procurement plan with items. Validates budget via Configuration Service for each item's budgetCode. Checks department+fiscal year uniqueness. HTTP: Configuration Service (budget validation), Workflow Service (schema + start per item, TAT defaults), File Management Service (if files), Access Management Service (guard).

Description: Runs TAT monitoring job. Checks publication, opening, and evaluation milestones for all plan items and requisitions. Creates TatJobRun record. Calculates TAT dates for each item. Checks DUE/BREACHED/COMPLETED status for each milestone. Creates/updates TatTrackingEvent records. Handles RECALCULATED events when dates change.
Criticality Reason: TAT monitoring is the procurement compliance engine. Identifies breached deadlines. Drives escalation. Failure means procurement timeline violations go undetected. Processes ALL plan items and requisitions.
Important Log Fields: job_run_id, items_processed, milestones_checked, due_count, breached_count, completed_count, trace_id
Dependencies: DB: Tender.TatJobRuns (create, update), Tender.TatTrackingEvents (create, read, update), Tender.ProcurementPlanItems (read), Tender.Requisitions (read), Tender.Tenders (read), Tender.TenderLots (count queries).
Observability Gap: Has basic logging but no custom metrics. No breach alerting. No job duration tracking.
Notes: InternalApiKeyGuard. Batch job processing all items. Has logging (only E-Procurement endpoint besides bulkCreate with any logging).

Description: Opens submitted bids for expired tenders. Disqualifies non-submitted bids. Marks no-bid lots. Creates evaluation sessions. Generates bid opening reports asynchronously (template from config, Handlebars rendering, PDF generation, file upload). Sends notifications. Uses raw SQL for tender status updates.
Criticality Reason: Bid opening is a major procurement milestone. Disqualification of non-submitted bids is irreversible. Report generation involves multiple external services. Raw SQL usage bypasses Sequelize safeguards. Async report generation with fire-and-forget pattern.
Domain Event: No — but should emit domain event
Important Log Fields: lots_processed, bids_opened, bids_disqualified, lots_no_bids, reports_generated, trace_id
Sensitive Data: Supplier names, TINs, bid amounts in opening report.
Dependencies: DB: Tender.TenderLots (read, update bulk), Tender.Tenders (read, raw SQL UPDATE), Tender.Bids (read, update bulk), Tender.TenderLotEvaluations (create), Tender.BidOpeningReports (create async). HTTP: Configuration Service (report config, report category settings), Auth Service (getBusinessSuppliersByBusinessIds for report), File Management Service (PDF upload), Notification Service (report generated).
Observability Gap: Has basic logging but no custom metrics. No bid opening metrics. Async report generation not tracked. Raw SQL bypasses ORM logging.
Notes: InternalApiKeyGuard. Batch job. Raw SQL UPDATE. Async fire-and-forget report generation.
